title.narrative: Strengthening GBV mitigation, prevention and response in the Rohingya refugee camps through multi-sectoral services and women-led support

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to enhance access to lifesaving, essential GBV services and support among survivors and those at risk of GBV in the Rohingya refugee camps. This UNWOMEN project 1) provides access to UN Women Multi-Purpose Women's Centres (MPWC) in the Rohingya refugee camps to 45,000 people, 2) provides GBV messaging through community outreach activities to 45,000 and 3) psycho-social support and/or GBV case management 1,200 people. The project provides life-saving assistance to 45,030 people, including 27,000 women, 18,000 children, and 2,250 persons with disabilities.The main objective of this project is to enhance access to lifesaving, essential GBV services and support among survivors and those at risk of GBV in the Rohingya refugee camps.
